acceptance: A package coordinate has a validated canonical namespace.package form, exactly two segments, and is preserved through manifest, lockfile, AST/HIR, linker, diagnostics and source mapping.
The parser accepts import acme.http and an optional local alias while builtin modules remain unqualified; package provenance is never flattened to an ambiguous identifier.
aipo.toml parses and validates package identity, version, entry, dependencies, targets and declared capabilities with stable diagnostics.
aipo.lock is canonical and deterministic: it records exact versions, sources, local content digests and dependency edges without timestamps or machine-specific absolute paths.

The first resolver supports local path dependencies, rejects missing dependencies, cycles and incompatible constraints deterministically, performs no network access and runs no install lifecycle scripts.
run, check, build and source disassembly use the same resolved package result and never silently rewrite a stale lockfile.
Positive and negative fixtures cover import provenance, manifest/lock round-trips, deterministic ordering, missing/cyclic dependencies, capability declarations and lock/source mismatch.
The new architecture and CLI contract are documented, no arbitrary install scripts are introduced, and the full workspace fmt, clippy, test and doc gates remain green.
